newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian court jails Briton for abusing minors.
newsitem.headline: Albanian court jails Briton for abusing minors.

text.p: A 34-year-old Briton was sentenced to two years imprisonment in Albania by a Tirana court on Friday for sexually abusing two young boys.
"We find Paul Thompson guilty of the charges of immoral acts with persons under the age of 14...and sentence him to two years in jail," judge Gjin Gjoni said.
The sentence was reduced from three years because Thompson had pleaded guilty to the charges.

Thompson, a resident of Ashford, Kent, begged for leniency in his final statement. "My life in England has been destroyed in the last three weeks...I beg the court to let me return to my family. I beg for mercy," he told the court.

Thompson, a divorced father of two, was arrested on August 25 in the Adriatic resort of Durres, about 45 km (30 miles) west of Tirana after befriending two boys, aged 11 and 12, and luring them into his hotel room.
The age of consent for heterosexual and homosexual relations in Albania is 14.
Thompson's lawyer told Reuters he would appeal against the verdict. "His mental situation is not so good," he said.
